messages:
Maya: Weekend poll — potluck Saturday afternoon at my place or a sunrise hike Sunday? I can do either but need a headcount. :plate_with_cutlery: :mountain:
Ibrahim: Potluck for me. I will bring my famous tabbouleh. Also willing to do sunrise if we aren’t planning a 5am alarm. :sleeping:
Carmen: I vote hike. Sunrise views + breakfast tacos after = unbeatable. :taco: :sunrise:
Noelle: Potluck sounds chill. I can bring dessert and a folding chair. If you pick hike, I’ll bring snacks instead.
Maya: Quick vote: P for potluck, H for hike. Reply with letter. I’ll lock in by 8pm.
Ibrahim: P
Carmen: H
Noelle: P
Maya: P (but I might be tempted to join a short hike afterwards if people want)
office-bot: Maya created a draft event: "Saturday Potluck @ Maya’s" Saturday 16:00. Attendees: Maya, Ibrahim, Noelle.
Maya: Potluck wins 3-1. Plan: Saturday 4pm at my place. Bring a serving utensil and label any items with allergens if needed. I’ll send address in DM. :house_with_garden:
Carmen: I’ll swing by for dessert and then maybe sneak off for a short sunset walk if anyone wants to join. Also will bring chips.
Ibrahim: Tabbouleh secured. Will bring reusable plates. See you Saturday!
Noelle: Dessert locked. Excited to try everyone’s dishes. Also I have a tiny speaker for background music.
Maya: Awesome — potluck team assembled. If plans change or someone wants to swap food items, update here. Also reminder: bring your Tupperware for leftovers. :bento:
